hook_segment.text: ראיתי את זה בטיקטוק ולא האמנתי שזה קיים...

causes_to_rate.a: Weak opening visual — flat catalog shot, no motion cue
causes_to_rate.c: AliExpress catalog feel — reads as a marketplace thumbnail, not organic TikTok
causes_to_rate.d: Generic hook text — no specific number/problem/surprise
causes_to_rate.e: Hook–product mismatch — text promises something the image doesn't show
causes_to_rate.h: Non-native Hebrew phrasing — grammatically valid but reads as translated/stilted

a.evidence: Identical to 003A's opening: 0s, 0.5s, 1s and 1.5s frames are the same static lifestyle photo (white + pink bag-sealers, plant, placemat, fork) -- pixel-identical composition across all four sub-second frames, zero motion. Confirms 003A/003B/003C/003D all reuse the same underlying static shot / footage, only the hook-text overlay differs between variants.

b.evidence: The two bag-sealer units are clearly visible and centered in frame from 0s -- product identity is not ambiguous.

c.evidence: Same as 003A: by 2s the video cuts to a raw AliExpress listing-page screenshot showing 'אבטחה ופרטיות' (security & privacy), 'החזרות חינם' (free returns), 'מסירה: יוני 25' (delivery date) and a yellow urgency banner 'רק עד 8 בעלי אקספרס' -- a literal scraped marketplace screenshot inside the hook window, not just catalog-style lighting/composition.

d.evidence: Hook text 'ראיתי את זה בטיקטוק ולא האמנתי שזה קיים...' ('I saw this on TikTok and couldn't believe it exists...') is a pure generic curiosity-bait template -- it never names the product's function, a number, or a specific problem. This exact phrase could be pasted onto literally any product video unchanged.

e.evidence: The text makes no specific promise beyond 'this exists' -- it doesn't claim a demonstrated action, so the static photo doesn't technically contradict it. (The bigger problem is the AliExpress-screenshot cut at 2s removing the product from view entirely, which is captured under (a)/(c) rather than a text/image mismatch.)

h.evidence: 'ראיתי את זה בטיקטוק ולא האמנתי שזה קיים' is natural, colloquial spoken Hebrew, a very common authentic-sounding TikTok opener -- not translated or stilted.

step11d_divergence_note: No STEP 11D pre-launch QA data exists for product 003 (confirmed: output/2026-06-14-product-003-upload_package.md has a STEP 3C section but no STEP 11D section at all), so no prediction-vs-reality divergence can be computed for this variant. Real-world finding: this variant reuses the identical static-photo-then-AliExpress-screenshot footage as 003A, but pairs it with a fully generic hook ('I saw this on TikTok...'). Retention was MARGINAL (45% at 2s, 360 views) -- slightly better than 003A's WEAK 38%, plausibly because the vaguer text makes no promise the visuals fail to keep, even though the underlying visual weaknesses (a)/(c) are identical.
